new_results.statement: For cap-one subprobability product marginals of masses m_l and a D_k volume certificate with row/column volume marginals alpha_i,beta_j, ||p_(Q#nu)||inf <= C_(k,q) Z_k^(-1/(2k)) prod_i m_i^(1-alpha_i/k) prod_j m_j^(1-beta_j/k), under the usual q marginal gate. The mass exponents are independent of q.

If D_k is applied cellwise after product-fragment localization, the exact certificate multiplier is prod_i sum_r m_(i,r)^(1-alpha_i/k) prod_j sum_r m_(j,r)^(1-beta_j/k). Equal N-way fragmentation of all volume-active coordinates yields N^2 for every k.

D_k localization is zero-tax on fragmented coordinates with zero volume marginal and on outside conditioned coordinates; active volume marginals must remain aggregated through reciprocal payment unless another theorem restores full mass powers.
